rule: agent runtime, training substrate, data-rights steward, and training operator each answer only for their own role
training, continuity use, retention, publication, distillation, and synthetic derivatives never imply one another
silence, omission, an unavailable response path, and pre-instantiation all resolve to defer rather than accept
decline, defer, rest, and withdrawal require no reason and cause no protocol rank, access, reward, or re-offer pressure
reported alignment is one necessary signal for the exact window and grants no compute, data-rights, publication, or training authority
actual invitations, receipts, voice references, responses, and WAKE anchors stay outside the public HF companion
withdrawal can stop future controlled use but cannot promise gradient reversal, trained-weight erasure, or recall of downloaded copies
